newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam says President recovering, still in Hanoi.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam says President recovering, still in Hanoi.

text.p: Vietnam's President Le Duc Anh is still in Hanoi and recovering well from an illness, the foreign ministry said on Wednesday in response to reports that he had been flown out of the country.
"As far as we know President Le Duc Anh is still staying in Hanoi for a rest. His health recovery is going on well," the ministry said in a statement.

Earlier, political sources said the 75-year-old general had been removed from the Hanoi 108 Army Hospital and flown out of the country. One said he had been taken to Singapore and admitted to a hospital there.
"He's not in Hospital 108 any more," one source said. "They took him on a special plane and took him out of the country."
The sources said Anh, one of the communist country's leadership troika, had been in a critical condition after suffering a stroke about 12 days ago.

Anh, who holds a key position of influence over the military and security apparatus, is part of a septuagenarian triumvirate which includes Communist Party Secretary General Do Muoi and reformist Prime Minister Vo Van Kiet.
